item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.117
item.description:
Release v1.0.117 adds sandbox CA certificate trust support, MCP/tool permission fixes, and several session/resume reliability improvements. It also fixes terminal/UI issues, permission prompt behavior, hooks/process handling, and model picker warnings.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.116
item.description:
Release 1.0.116 adds several CLI and editor integration fixes, including MCP/server startup and auth handling, sandbox and permissions behavior, session and model workflow improvements, and multiple terminal/UI accessibility corrections. It also includes changes for extension manifests, workspace MCP config parsing, search and diff edge cases, and memory growth reduction in long sessions.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Use Azure Storage permissions in Azure AI Search and Foundry IQ
item.description:
Azure AI Search and Foundry IQ now support Azure Storage permissions to control access to search results. When configured, search apps and AI agents return only content each user is allowed to access.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.115
item.description:
Release v1.0.115 adds many CLI fixes and UI/layout improvements, plus new model and provider support. It also tightens sandbox, MCP, permissions, session-resume, and background-process handling across macOS, Windows, and Unix.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: Security advisory permissions are now generally available
item.description:
GitHub now supports using custom repository roles to grant access for working on repository security advisories, including private vulnerability reports. This removes the need to make users repository administrators just for advisory work.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol support in Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent adds public preview support for the open Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. This lets SRE agents delegate tasks to other agents and receive tasks from them while preserving each team’s permissions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.111
item.description:
Release v1.0.111 adds new permission-rule regex support, a one-time remote host session creation flag, and several MCP/plugin/workflow/session fixes. It also includes many terminal UI, rendering, and reliability fixes across /usage, /diff, /resume, search, paste handling, and startup/sign-in flows.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.109
item.description:
Release 1.0.109 focuses on CLI/IDE session reliability, settings/help text corrections, and permission/model handling fixes. It also adds IPv4/IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host allow/deny rules and support for Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.108
item.description:
Release v1.0.108 adds numerous CLI behavior fixes, help-text updates, and MCP/autopilot improvements. Notable changes include better session/resume handling, more consistent permission and tool-call behavior, improved search and transcript rendering, and default installation/activation for managed plugins marked defaultEnabled.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.104
item.description:
Version 1.0.104 changes session startup and fallback behavior for Auto/Autopilot modes, updates how background-task waiting is handled, and makes Assisted Permissions available without experimental mode.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot assisted permissions are now generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and Visual Studio Code. The feature lets Copilot request permission before running commands or accessing file system paths.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.101
item.description:
Release v1.0.101 adds several CLI and MCP workflow fixes, including native structured output for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models, new assisted approval instructions, and more reliable sign-in and permission handling. It also fixes model selection, session resume/startup behavior, Windows/macOS shell command issues, and multiple provider-specific request and image-limit problems.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.100
item.description:
Release v1.0.100 adds new CLI flags and session/share commands, expands plugin and sandbox handling, and improves account, permission, and model management flows. It also fixes a wide range of reliability issues across MCP, Gemini, Windows, proxy, telemetry, and session browsing.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: GitHub App improvements for least privilege and management
item.description:
GitHub released several GitHub App changes aimed at reducing reliance on classic PATs, improving app management, and helping apps request fewer sensitive permissions. The post indicates additional usability improvements for managing GitHub Apps, but the excerpt does not include the full list of changes.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.97
item.description:
Release v1.0.97 adds agent-scoped declarative hooks, improves plugin/MCP handling, and fixes multiple session, permissions, and UI issues. It also changes inline images to render by default on supported terminals and includes several data/output correctness fixes.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Enabling the Bulk admin role for SQL Server on Linux
item.description:
SQL Server on Linux now supports the bulkadmin fixed server role and the ADMINISTER BULK OPERATIONS permission starting with SQL Server 2025 CU9 and SQL Server 2022 CU27. This enables bulk data import operations without requiring users to be members of the sysadmin role.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Control GitHub Actions cache access with cache-mode
item.description:
GitHub Actions now supports cache-mode to control cache access at the workflow or job level. This lets you grant least-privilege cache access instead of broad cache permissions.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Business and Enterprise admins can now centrally manage agent operation permissions. Admins can set operations to be blocked, require human approval, or run without prompting.

  • Source: GitHub
